name: Ca chinh and ca bong tuong
nameVi: Cá chình và cá bống tượng Tân Thành
summary: Cá chình and cá bống tượng Tân Thành are one collective trademark. Nhân Dân, reporting the 23 December 2022 workshop, lists the pair as a single protected product.
origin: Tân Thành, the place name on the mark. Nhân Dân does not say which kitchen cooks them.
howToEat: Nhân Dân names the mark and does not print a recipe, a cut, or a price. Check on arrival.
where: Tân Thành, as the mark is printed. No stall is named. Check on arrival.
